caption:
four features, one afternoon, zero juggling

#gym #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
The gym photo started it

The *streak* closed it

Scanned the free corner

Got a session built
from what was there

Water: a tap per glass

Streak: 3 days
and counting

The point isn't logging

It's that everything
lands in one picture

slides.heading: One app, the whole loop
slides.body: Scan the gym, get the session, log the workout and the water — SOMA keeps the day in one picture
